Module io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations
Package io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.security

Annotation Interface SecurityRequirement

@Target({METHOD,TYPE,ANNOTATION_TYPE}) @Retention(RUNTIME) @Repeatable(SecurityRequirements.class) @Inherited public @interface SecurityRequirement
The annotation may be applied at class or method level, or in Operation.security() to define security requirements for the single operation (when applied at method level) or for all operations of a class (when applied at class level).

It can also be used in OpenAPIDefinition.security() to define spec level security.

combine() can be used to define multiple security requirements at the same time, requiring each one of them. If only one of multiple security schemes is required, use multiple SecurityRequirement annotations.
